# Stage 1: transpile TypeScript to JavaScript
FROM node:24 AS build
ARG NODE_MAX_OLD_SPACE_SIZE=4096
ENV NODE_OPTIONS="--max_old_space_size=${NODE_MAX_OLD_SPACE_SIZE}"

WORKDIR /build/components/sign-tool

# Copy package.json and package-lock.json
COPY package*.json .

# Install all dependencies
RUN npm ci

# Copy repository files
COPY . .

# Build the project
RUN npm run build

# Stage 2: runtime image
FROM node:24-slim AS runtime

# Set the configuration path
ENV CONFIG_PATH=/var/www/config

# Set the working directory
WORKDIR /var/www/components/sign-tool

# Copy package files and install dependencies
COPY package*.json .
---
{
  "name": "liquio-task",
  "version": "0.1.34",
  "engines": {
    "node": "24"
  },
  "private": true,
  "license": "SEE LICENSE IN ../../LICENSE.md",
  "main": "src/index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "start": "node src/index.js",
    "start:prod": "node src/index.js",
    "start:ts": "node -r ts-node/register src/index.ts",
    "start:dev": "DISABLE_LOG=true node index.js",
    "build": "tsc",
    "migration-up": "sequelize db:migrate",
    "migration-clear": "sequelize db:migrate:undo:all",
    "lint": "eslint \"**/*.{js,ts}\" && npm run test:build",
    "lint:fix": "eslint \"**/*.{js,ts}\" --fix",
    "test": "jest src",
    "test:watch": "jest --watch src",
    "test:cov": "jest --coverage src",
    "test:e2e": "jest tests",
    "test:build": "tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json",
    "command": "node bin/index.js",
    "plugin-installer": "liquio-plugin-installer"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@liquio/back-core": "^0.2.3",
    "@liquio/plugin-installer": "^0.1.3",
    "@liquio/plugin-sdk": "^0.1.5",
    "ajv": "^6.12.6",
    "amqplib": "^0.10.9",
    "axios": "^1.13.6",
    "body-parser": "^2.3.0",
    "cors": "^2.8.6",
    "cyrillic-to-translit-js": "^3.1.0",
    "express": "^5.2.1",
    "express-form-data": "^2.0.10",
    "express-validator": "^6.6.0",

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat components/sign-tool/Dockerfile 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "---"; cat components/task/package.json | head -40
